To automate its factories as well as those of its suppliers and subsidiaries through the use of robotics, Toyota Motor
estimates it will cost 1 trillion yen ($6.4B) per year from 2028.
The estimate includes the costs for upgrading current machinery and new installations with as many as 400,000 humanoid and non-humanoid robots.
flagship humanoid robot, Eley, which uses two-fingered hands and moves on wheels powered by batteries or an electrical cord (versus bipedal robots used by Tesla).
Eley learns by observation, rather than relying on datasets, a distinction that enables Eley to be deployed across Toyota factories without repeat training.

title: Toyota's automation effort could cost $6.4B per year
